name: Lau ba khia
summary: Lẩu ba khía lá buôi is a mangrove-crab hotpot with a fatty, clean-sweet crab riêu. The leaf, also called rau bộ đội, is nutty and wants a thorough cook.
howToEat: Share the pot after a day on the creeks. Dip lá buôi until it is fully cooked.
seoTitle: Lau ba khia — mangrove crab hotpot in Can Gio
seoDescription: Lẩu ba khía lá buôi is a mangrove-crab hotpot with a fatty, clean-sweet riêu and a nutty leaf.
culture: Dân Việt says lá buôi was food for the Rừng Sác special forces and later a home leaf.
texture: The crab riêu is fatty. The leaf is nutty.
